Your network includes an on-premises Active Directory domain named `contoso.com`.  
  
For every user account, the **Logon Hours** settings are configured to block sign-ins outside business hours.  
  
You plan to synchronize `contoso.com` with an Azure AD tenant.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that ensures the logon-hour restrictions are enforced when synchronized users sign in to Azure AD.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?
questions.explanation:
Pass-through authentication validates each sign-in against on-premises Active Directory and enforces its account policies in real time, including denying a sign-in attempted outside the user’s permitted logon hours.

**Learn more:** [Authentication for Microsoft Entra hybrid identity solutions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/connect/choose-ad-authn)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 tenant.  
  
You plan to manage incidents in the tenant by using Microsoft Defender XDR.  
  
Which Microsoft service source will be shown on the Incidents page in the Microsoft Defender portal?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Identity is a Microsoft Defender XDR service that contributes identity-threat alerts to the unified incident queue. Defender XDR correlates alerts from its supported Defender services into incidents in the Microsoft Defender portal.\
\
**Learn more:** [Turn on Microsoft Defender XDR](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/m365d-enable) · [Prioritize incidents in the Microsoft Defender portal](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/incident-queue)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that includes 1,000 Windows devices.  
  
You need to review the devices’ exposure score.  
  
Which portal should you use?
questions.explanation:
The endpoint exposure score is a Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management metric that indicates how vulnerable an organization’s devices are to cybersecurity threats. It is reviewed in the Microsoft Defender portal, under Exposure management and Vulnerability management.\
\
**Learn more:** [Exposure score in Defender Vulnerability Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-vulnerability-management/tvm-exposure-score) · [Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management overview page](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-vulnerability-management/tvm-dashboard-insights)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription containing an Azure AD tenant named contoso.com. The tenant has a user named User1.  
  
You enable Azure AD Identity Protection.  
  
You must ensure that User1 can review the Azure AD Identity Protection list of users flagged as risky. The solution must follow the principle of least privilege.  
  
To which role should you add User1?
questions.explanation:
The Security Administrator role provides access to Azure AD Identity Protection risk information, including the risky-users report. It is the least-privileged listed role that supports this access; Global Administrator provides unnecessary tenant-wide privileges, and Service Administrator and Reports Reader do not provide the required current access to the risky-users report.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Entra ID Protection risky user report](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-protection/concept-risky-user-report)

Your company has a Microsoft Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) tenant named contoso.com that contains the users shown in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1784204299976-ie1m8hju.png)  
  
Group2 is a member of Group1.  
  
You assign a Microsoft Office 365 Enterprise E3 license to Group1.  
  
How many Office 365 E3 licenses are assigned?
questions.explanation:
Group-based licensing does not support nested groups, so Group2 does not pass the Group1 license to User2. Of Group1’s direct user members, only User1 and User4 have usage locations configured; User3 cannot receive the license until a usage location is set. Thus, two Office 365 E3 licenses are assigned.\
\
**Learn more:** [Assign or unassign licenses to a group in the Microsoft 365 admin center](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/manage/manage-group-licenses?view=o365-worldwide)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that includes a user named User1.  
  
User1 needs administrative access to complete the following tasks:  
  
- Manage Microsoft Exchange Online settings.  
- Create Microsoft 365 groups.  
  
You need to ensure that User1 has administrative access for only eight hours and must receive approval before the role assignment occurs.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management (PIM) provides just-in-time privileged access through eligible role assignments. PIM can require approval for role activation and enforce a maximum activation duration, such as eight hours, for Microsoft Entra roles that administer Microsoft 365 services.

**Learn more:** [Plan a Privileged Identity Management deployment](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-governance/privileged-identity-management/pim-deployment-plan) · [Assign Microsoft Entra roles in Privileged Identity Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-governance/privileged-identity-management/pim-how-to-add-role-to-user)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
You plan to implement Microsoft Purview policies to satisfy these requirements:  
  
- Identify documents stored in Microsoft Teams and SharePoint that contain Personally Identifiable Information (PII).  
- Report on shared documents that contain PII.  
  
What should you create?

options.text: a Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps policy

questions.explanation:
A Microsoft Purview data loss prevention (DLP) policy can use sensitive information types to detect PII in SharePoint documents, including files shared through Teams because Teams stores shared files in SharePoint or OneDrive. DLP rules can also evaluate whether content is shared and generate incident reports for matching items.

**Learn more:** [Data loss prevention and Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/dlp-microsoft-teams) · [Help prevent sharing sensitive items via SharePoint and OneDrive with external users](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-ie/purview/dlp-create-policy-spo-odb-external)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your network has an on-premises Active Directory domain named contoso.com. The domain includes the objects shown in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783845838515-q7gb8bkq.png)  
  
You configure Azure AD Connect to synchronize contoso.com with Azure AD. Which objects will synchronize to Azure AD?
questions.explanation:
Azure AD Connect synchronizes eligible Active Directory users and groups in its synchronization scope. Disabled user accounts are synchronized to Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) as well; account disablement alone does not exclude them. A global security group is also an eligible group object.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Entra Connect Sync: Understanding Users, Groups, and Contacts](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/connect/concept-azure-ad-connect-sync-user-and-contacts)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
All users have Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise licenses assigned.  
  
You need to ensure that reports show the names of users who activated Microsoft 365 apps and the number of devices on which they activated them.  
  
What should you change in the Microsoft 365 admin center?
questions.explanation:
The Microsoft 365 Apps Activations report provides per-user activation and device information. User-specific details are concealed in usage reports by default; the organization-wide **Reports** setting controls whether identifiable user names are displayed.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft 365 admin center usage reports overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/activity-reports/activity-reports?view=o365-worldwide) · [Microsoft 365 Apps Activations Report](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/activity-reports/microsoft-office-activations-ww?view=o365-worldwide)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription containing the domains shown in the following exhibit.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783845852091-i4gfpmxt.png)  
  
Which domain-name suffixes can you use when creating users?

options.text: all the domains in the subscription

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra user principal names can use any verified domain in the tenant. Domain ownership verification is distinct from configuring DNS records for Microsoft 365 services; an Incomplete setup or Possible service issues status identifies outstanding service configuration, not a restriction on using the domain as a user suffix. Consequently, every listed domain-name suffix is available for user creation.

**Learn more:** [domain resource type - Microsoft Graph v1.0](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/domain?view=graph-rest-1.0) · [Find and fix issues after adding your domain or DNS records - Microsoft 365 admin](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/get-help-with-domains/find-and-fix-issues?view=o365-worldwide)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that includes Microsoft Intune.  
  
You manage all iOS devices by using Intune.  
  
You plan to protect corporate-owned iOS devices with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. You configure a connection between Intune and Defender for Endpoint.  
  
You need to onboard the devices to Defender for Endpoint.  
  
What should you do?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint on iOS is onboarded by deploying the Microsoft Defender app to the Intune-managed devices. App protection policies use threat signals to protect application data, and they do not deploy or onboard the Defender client.

**Learn more:** [Deploy Microsoft Defender for Endpoint on iOS with Microsoft Intune](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/defender-endpoint/ios-install) · [Configure Microsoft Defender for Endpoint with Intune and onboard devices](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/device-security/microsoft-defender/configure-integration)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your network includes two on-premises Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) forests, named contoso.com and fabrikam.com, connected by a forest trust.  
  
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
You need to synchronize a subset of users from both forests to Microsoft Entra. The solution must support device objects and device writeback.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra Connect Sync supports synchronization from multiple on-premises AD DS forests, object filtering to synchronize only a subset of users, and device writeback. Device writeback is a Microsoft Entra Connect Sync feature that writes Microsoft Entra device objects back to on-premises Active Directory.

**Learn more:** [What is Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync?](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/entra/identity/hybrid/cloud-sync/what-is-cloud-sync) · [Microsoft Entra Connect: Enabling device writeback](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/connect/how-to-connect-device-writeback)

You have the policies displayed in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783847597425-4aee54ir.png)  
  
All policies are configured to send malicious email messages to quarantine.  
  
Which policies support a custom quarantine retention period?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Office 365 supports a customizable quarantine retention period for anti-spam and anti-phishing policies. Quarantined messages from anti-malware and Safe Attachments policies have a fixed 30-day retention period.\
\

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company has a Microsoft Entra tenant named contoso.com and a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
All users access Microsoft Office 365 apps from Windows 10 devices.  
  
All devices are in a workgroup.  
  
You plan to implement passwordless sign-in to contoso.com.  
  
You need to recommend infrastructure changes for the planned implementation.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?

options.text: Join all the devices to contoso.com.
Deploy the Microsoft Entra Connect provisioning agent.

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Authenticator enables passwordless sign-in to Microsoft Entra accounts by using a device-bound cryptographic credential protected by a PIN or biometric. It supports Microsoft 365 cloud-app access without requiring the Windows devices to be Microsoft Entra joined.

**Learn more:** [Enable passwordless sign-in with Microsoft Authenticator](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/howto-authentication-passwordless-phone) · [Microsoft Entra registered devices](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/devices/concept-device-registration)

questions.domain: Deploy and manage a Microsoft 365 tenant
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Overview  
  
Fabrikam, Inc. is an electronics company that manufactures consumer products. Fabrikam has 10,000 employees worldwide.  
  
Fabrikam has a headquarters in London and branch offices in major cities across Europe, Asia, and the United States.  
  
Existing Environment  
  
Active Directory Environment  
  
The network has an Active Directory forest named `fabrikam.com`. The forest contains every identity used for user and computer authentication. Each department is represented by a top-level organizational unit (OU) that includes several child OUs for user accounts and computer accounts.  
  
All users authenticate to on-premises applications by signing in to their device using the UPN format of `[email protected]`.  
  
Fabrikam does **not** plan to implement identity federation.  
  
Network Infrastructure  
  
Each office has a high-speed Internet connection.  
  
Each office has two domain controllers. Every domain controller is configured as a DNS server.  
  
The public zone for `fabrikam.com` is managed on an external DNS server.  
  
All users connect to an on-premises Microsoft Exchange Server 2016 organization. Users access email by using Outlook Anywhere, Outlook on the web, or the Microsoft Outlook app for iOS. All Exchange servers have the latest cumulative updates installed.  
  
All shared company documents are stored on a Microsoft SharePoint Server farm.  
  
Requirements  
  
Planned Changes  
  
Fabrikam plans to implement a Microsoft 365 Enterprise subscription and migrate all email and shared documents to the subscription.  
  
Fabrikam plans to implement two pilot projects:  
  
- Project1: During Project1, the mailboxes of 100 users in the sales department will be migrated to Microsoft 365.  
- Project2: After Project1 completes successfully, Microsoft Teams will be enabled in Microsoft 365 for sales department users.  
  
Fabrikam plans to create a group named `UserLicenses` to manage the allocation of all Microsoft 365 bulk licenses.  
  
Technical Requirements  
  
Fabrikam identifies these technical requirements:  
  
- During Project1, all users must be able to successfully exchange email messages by using their current email address.  
- Users must be able to authenticate to cloud services if Active Directory becomes unavailable.  
- A user named User1 must be able to view all DLP reports from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.  
- Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise applications must be installed only from a network share.  
- Disruptions to email access must be minimized.  
  
Application Requirements  
  
Fabrikam identifies these application requirements:  
  
- An on-premises web application named App1 must enable users to complete their expense reports online. App1 must be available to users from the My Apps portal.  
- Installation of feature updates for Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise must be minimized.  
  
Security Requirements  
  
Fabrikam identifies these security requirements:  
  
- After the planned migration to Microsoft 365, all users must continue authenticating to their mailbox and SharePoint sites by using their UPN.  
- Membership of the `UserLicenses` group must be validated monthly. Unused user accounts must be removed from the group automatically.  
- After the planned migration to Microsoft 365, all users must be signed in to on-premises and cloud-based applications automatically.  
- The principle of least privilege must be used.  
  
You are assessing the processes required for Project1.  
  
You need to recommend the DNS record that must be created when adding a domain name for the project.  
  
Which DNS record should you recommend?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft 365 uses a DNS TXT record to verify ownership of a custom domain. The TXT verification record does not alter existing mail routing, so it supports validating the domain while minimizing disruption to the current email service. [Add a custom domain to Microsoft 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/setup/add-domain?view=o365-worldwide)

**Learn more:** [Add a custom domain to Microsoft 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/setup/add-domain?view=o365-worldwide)

questions.domain: Deploy and manage a Microsoft 365 tenant
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
Users use Android or iOS devices and access Microsoft 365 resources from computers running Windows 11 or MacOS.  
  
You need to implement passwordless authentication. The solution must support every device.  
  
Which authentication method should you use?
questions.explanation:
FIDO2-compliant security keys provide passwordless authentication across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. Windows Hello is Windows-specific, and Microsoft Authenticator passwordless phone sign-in is intended for supported Android and iOS mobile devices.\
\
**Learn more:** [Passkey (FIDO2) authentication matrix with Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/concept-fido2-compatibility)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR

You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
Users use Android or iOS devices and access Microsoft 365 resources from computers running Windows 11 or MacOS.  
  
You need to implement passwordless authentication. The solution must support every device.  
  
Which authentication method should you use?
questions.explanation:
A group can receive multiple product licenses, and every member inherits those assigned licenses. An all-users group can therefore provide both Office 365 E3 with Power Automate disabled and Enterprise Mobility + Security E5. Separate research and marketing groups are required because Power BI Pro and Visio Plan 2 must be assigned to different, nonidentical sets of users. The three groups can overlap through membership.

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription containing a Microsoft Entra tenant named contoso.com. The tenant has a user named User1.  
  
You enable Microsoft Entra ID Protection.  
  
You need to ensure that User1 can review the Microsoft Entra ID Protection list of users identified as risky. The solution must follow the principle of least privilege.  
  
To which role should you add User1?
questions.explanation:
The Security Reader role provides read-only access to Microsoft Entra ID Protection, including all ID Protection reports and the overview. It therefore allows review of risky users without granting permissions to change policies or take remediation actions.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Entra ID Protection risky user report](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-protection/concept-risky-user-report) · [Microsoft Entra built-in roles](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/role-based-access-control/permissions-reference)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription and use Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps.  
  
You plan to conduct a security audit of every app detected by Cloud Discovery.  
  
You need to track which apps have been audited. The solution must ensure that the list of audited apps can be displayed in the cloud app catalog.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Define each app as a critical asset.
Generate a Cloud Discovery snapshot report.
Apply a custom app tag to each app.

questions.explanation:
Custom app tags can be applied to apps discovered through Cloud Discovery, and the Cloud app catalog supports filtering by app tags, including custom tags. A custom tag such as “Audited” therefore identifies each reviewed app and displays the audited-app set in the catalog.

**Learn more:** [Discovered app filters and queries - Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-cloud-apps/discovered-app-queries) · [Find your cloud app and calculate risk scores](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-cloud-apps/risk-score)

questions.domain: Manage compliance by using Microsoft Purview
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription with the published sensitivity labels shown in the following exhibit.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783918986600-sqepy893.png)  
  
Which labels can users apply to content?

options.text: Label1, Label3, Label4, and Label6 only
Label1, Label2, Label3, Label4, Label5, and Label6

questions.explanation:
A parent sensitivity label cannot be applied to content after it has sublabels; users select the parent only to choose an applicable sublabel. Therefore, Label2 and Label5 are not directly applicable. Label1 is a standalone label, and Label3, Label4, and Label6 are sublabels, so users can apply those four labels.\
\
**Learn more:** [PowerShell advanced settings for Microsoft Purview Information Protection client](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/exchange/client-advanced-settings?view=exchange-ps)

questions.domain: Manage compliance by using Microsoft Purview
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
You need to be notified whenever a user in the service desk department grants Full Access permission to a user mailbox.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
An alert policy can generate a notification when the audited Exchange activity for adding delegate mailbox permissions (`Add-MailboxPermission`) occurs, and it can be scoped to the relevant service desk users. This activity records the assignment of FullAccess permission to another user’s mailbox.\
\
**Learn more:** [Alert policies in the Microsoft Defender portal](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/alert-policies-defender-portal) · [Audit log activities](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/audit-log-activities)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
You need to be notified whenever a user in the service desk department grants Full Access permission to a user mailbox.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra ID Protection automatically adds users actively assigned the Global Administrator, Security Administrator, or Security Reader role to the Users at risk detected alerts recipient list when they have a valid Email or Alternate email address. Security Operator is not one of the automatically included roles, so the Security Administrator and Security Reader accounts are added.

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that includes a user named User1.  
  
You create an outbound anti-spam policy named Policy1, as shown in the following exhibit.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783878174250-mt2412yj.png)  
  
You assign Policy1 to User1.  
  
What is the maximum number of email messages that User1 can send during a 24-hour period?
questions.explanation:
In an outbound anti-spam policy, the external and internal message limits are per-hour recipient rate limits, while the daily message limit is the total recipients per day. With an external limit of 10/hour and an internal limit of 20/hour, User1 can send to at most 30 recipients per hour, which over 24 hours totals 720. Because 720 is below the configured daily limit of 1000, the daily cap is never the binding constraint. The maximum number of messages in a 24-hour period is therefore 720.

**Learn more:** [Configure outbound spam policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/outbound-spam-policies-configure)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Microsoft Intune.  
  
All devices run Windows 11 and are joined to Microsoft Entra.  
  
You receive an alert about a zero-day attack.  
  
You need to determine which devices were affected by the attack and send Intune administrators a request to update those affected devices.  
  
Which two actions should you take in the Microsoft Defender portal? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: From Threat analytics, view the list of vulnerable devices.
From Incidents & alerts, select the latest incident.
From Vulnerability management, open the security recommendation.
Select the affected devices and request remediation.

questions.explanation:
Threat analytics exposes the devices that run software vulnerable to vulnerabilities linked to a tracked threat. Defender Vulnerability Management sends an Intune remediation request from a security recommendation, where the remediation options create a task for IT administrators to address.

**Learn more:** [Threat analytics in Microsoft Defender](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/threat-analytics) · [Security recommendations - Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-vulnerability-management/tvm-security-recommendation)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your network contains an Active Directory domain named adatum.com that synchronizes with a Microsoft Entra tenant.  
  
The domain includes 100 user accounts.  
  
The city attribute for every user is set to the city in which that user resides.  
  
You need to change each city attribute value to that city’s three-letter airport code.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: From Windows PowerShell on a domain controller, run the Get-MgUser and Update-MgUser cmdlets.
From Azure Cloud Shell, run the Get-MgUser and Update-MgUser cmdlets.
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, select the users, and then use the Bulk actions option.
From Windows PowerShell on a domain controller, run the Get-ADUser and Set-ADUser cmdlets.

questions.explanation:
For users synchronized from Active Directory Domain Services, the on-premises directory remains the source of authority. The city attribute should therefore be updated in AD DS with the Active Directory PowerShell cmdlets; synchronization then propagates the updated value to Microsoft Entra ID.

**Learn more:** [Configure user Source of Authority (SOA) in Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/how-to-user-source-of-authority-configure) · [Microsoft Entra Connect Sync: Attributes synchronized to Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/connect/reference-connect-sync-attributes-synchronized)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
You create a data loss prevention (DLP) policy named DLP1.  
  
You need to make sure endpoint rule actions are available in the advanced DLP rules for DLP1.  
  
To which location should you apply DLP1?
questions.explanation:
Endpoint DLP rule actions, including **Audit or restrict activities on devices**, require the DLP policy to be scoped to the **Devices** location. Microsoft documents device-only scoping for policies that use these endpoint actions.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create a DLP policy that uses device scoping](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/endpoint-dlp-create-policy-device-scoping) · [Create and deploy a data loss prevention policy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/dlp-create-deploy-policy)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 tenant.  
  
You create an auto-labeling policy that encrypts emails containing a sensitive information type. You specify the locations to which the policy will apply.  
  
You need to deploy the policy.  
  
What should you do first?

options.text: Run the policy in simulation mode.
Review the sensitive information in Activity explorer.

questions.explanation:
An auto-labeling policy should run in simulation mode before it is enabled. Simulation evaluates the configured sensitive-information condition and locations without applying the label or encryption, so matched emails can be reviewed and the policy can be refined before production enforcement.\
\
**Learn more:** [Automatically apply a sensitivity label to Microsoft 365 data](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/microsoft-365/compliance/apply-sensitivity-label-automatically?view=o365-worldwide)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 tenant.  
  
You create an auto-labeling policy that encrypts emails containing a sensitive information type. You specify the locations to which the policy will apply.  
  
You need to deploy the policy.  
  
What should you do first?
questions.explanation:
An MX record specifies the mail server responsible for receiving email for a domain. For a Microsoft 365 mailbox migration that must retain users’ existing email addresses, the domain’s MX record is required to route incoming mail to Exchange Online. CNAME records provide aliases, HINFO records describe host hardware/software, and AAAA records map a name to an IPv6 address.

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your network includes an Active Directory forest named `contoso.local`.  
  
You purchase a Microsoft 365 subscription. You plan to migrate to Microsoft 365 and implement a hybrid deployment solution for the next 12 months.  
  
You need to prepare for the planned move to Microsoft 365.  
  
What is the best action to take before implementing directory synchronization? More than one answer choice may meet the objective. Select the **BEST** answer.
questions.explanation:
A `.local` Active Directory domain is non-routable and cannot be used as the verified Microsoft 365 domain for synchronized user sign-in names. Purchasing a custom, internet-routable domain allows it to be verified in Microsoft Entra ID and used for users’ UPN suffixes before synchronization. Renaming the Active Directory forest is unnecessary.

**Learn more:** [Prepare a non-routable domain for directory synchronization](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/prepare-a-non-routable-domain-for-directory-synchronization?view=o365-worldwide) · [Synchronize domain users to Microsoft 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/setup/manage-domain-users?view=o365-worldwide)

questions.domain: Manage compliance by using Microsoft Purview
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription and register two applications, **App1** and **App2**, in Azure AD.  
  
You need to ensure that users connecting to App1 must use multi-factor authentication (MFA). MFA must be required only for App1. What should you do?

options.text: From the Microsoft Entra admin center, create a conditional access policy.
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, configure the Modem authentication settings.
From the Enterprise applications blade of the Microsoft Entra admin center, configure the Users settings.
From Multi-Factor Authentication, configure the service settings.

questions.explanation:
A Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policy can target App1 as its cloud application and use the **Require multifactor authentication** grant control for the intended users. This enforces MFA for access to App1 without requiring it for App2.

**Learn more:** [Build Conditional Access policies in Microsoft Entra](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/conditional-access/concept-conditional-access-policies)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a hybrid Microsoft 365 deployment that includes the users shown in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783845860121-5ygss0x6.png)  
  
Azure AD Connect is configured with the following settings:  
  
- Password Hash Sync: Enabled  
- Pass-through authentication: Enabled  
  
You need to determine which users can authenticate by using Azure AD if connectivity between the on-premises Active Directory and the Internet is lost.  
  
Which users should you identify?
questions.explanation:
Pass-through authentication validates passwords against on-premises AD DS through an on-premises agent, so synchronized AD DS users cannot be authenticated when that connectivity is unavailable. Although password hash synchronization is enabled, pass-through authentication does not automatically fail over to it; an administrator must change the sign-in method. A cloud-only Azure AD account does not rely on on-premises AD DS for authentication.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Entra Connect: Pass-through Authentication FAQ](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/connect/how-to-connect-pta-faq) · [User sign-in with Microsoft Entra pass-through authentication](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/connect/how-to-connect-pta)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps can send policy alerts to Microsoft Power Automate, where a playbook can automate a custom response workflow. Microsoft Defender XDR custom detection rules can automatically apply the **Mark user as compromised** response action to returned users; this sets the user's Microsoft Entra ID risk level to high and triggers applicable identity-protection policies.

**Learn more:** [Integrate with Microsoft Power Automate for custom alert automation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-cloud-apps/flow-integration) · [Create custom detection rules in Microsoft Defender XDR](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/custom-detection-rules)

questions.domain: Implement and manage Microsoft Entra identity and access
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that includes an Azure AD tenant named contoso.com.  
  
Corporate policy requires that user passwords must not contain the word Contoso.  
  
What should you do to enforce the corporate policy?

options.text: From the Microsoft Entra admin center, create a conditional access policy.
From the Microsoft Entra admin center, configure the Password protection settings.
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, configure the Password policy settings.
From Azure AD Identity Protection, configure a sign-in risk policy.

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra Password Protection provides a custom banned password list for organization-specific terms, including company names. Adding `Contoso` to that list blocks its use in user passwords.\
\
**Learn more:** [Eliminate bad passwords using Microsoft Entra Password Protection](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/concept-password-ban-bad)

questions.question:
You use Microsoft Defender for Office 365.  
  
You plan to automate an attack simulation campaign.  
  
Any users who fail the simulation must complete additional training based on the simulation results.  
  
What is the maximum number of days that the training will remain available to users after the simulation?
questions.explanation:
For simulation automations, the training due-date choices are 7, 15, or 30 days after the simulation ends. Therefore, training can remain available for a maximum of 30 days.\
\
**Learn more:** [Simulation automations for Attack simulation training](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/attack-simulation-training-simulation-automations)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.  
  
All devices in your organization are onboarded to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.  
  
You need to ensure that an alert is generated when malicious activity is detected on a device during the past 24 hours.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: From the Microsoft Purview compliance portal, create a data loss prevention (DLP) policy.
From Alerts queue, create a suppression rule and assign an alert.
From Advanced hunting, create a query and a detection rule.
From the Microsoft Purview compliance portal, create an audit log search.

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender XDR custom detection rules use Advanced hunting queries to monitor endpoint events at scheduled intervals and generate alerts when query results match. A detection query can filter for malicious activity from the last 24 hours and create the required alert.

**Learn more:** [Create custom detection rules in Microsoft Defender XDR](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/custom-detection-rules) · [Advanced hunting overview in Microsoft Defender XDR](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/advanced-hunting-overview)

questions.domain: Implement and manage Microsoft Entra identity and access
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription and use Microsoft Purview. The subscription includes the devices shown in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783892898557-74zol4md.png)  
  
All devices are onboarded to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.  
  
You plan to deploy Endpoint data loss prevention (Endpoint DLP) policies.  
  
Which devices can be protected by using the DLP policies?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP supports onboarded Windows 10/Windows 11 devices and supported macOS devices. It does not provide Endpoint DLP protection for Android or Linux endpoints, so the supported devices are Device1 and Device2.

**Learn more:** [Get started with endpoint data loss prevention](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/endpoint-dlp-getting-started)

questions.domain: Deploy and manage a Microsoft 365 tenant
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your network includes an Active Directory forest named contoso.local.  
  
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
You plan to deploy a directory synchronization solution that will use password hash synchronization.  
  
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, you successfully verified the contoso.com domain name.  
  
You need to prepare the environment for the planned directory synchronization solution.  
  
What should you do first?

options.text: From the Microsoft 365 admin center, verify the contoso.local domain name.
From the public DNS zone of contoso.com, add a new mail exchanger (MX) record.
From Active Directory Domains and Trusts, add contoso.com as a UPN suffix.
From Active Directory Users and Computers, modify the UPN suffix for all users.

questions.explanation:
A nonroutable `.local` AD DS UPN suffix should be replaced with a suffix for a verified, internet-routable Microsoft 365 domain. Adding `contoso.com` as an alternative UPN suffix in Active Directory Domains and Trusts makes that suffix available before it can be assigned to users. Microsoft Entra Connect uses the on-premises UPN for sign-in synchronization; UPN suffixes should map to verified Microsoft Entra ID domains.

**Learn more:** [Prepare a nonroutable domain for directory synchronization](https://learn.microsoft.com/ga-ie/microsoft-365/enterprise/prepare-a-non-routable-domain-for-directory-synchronization?view=o365-worldwide&viewFallbackFrom=o365-germany) · [Plan and troubleshoot User Principal Name changes in Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/connect/howto-troubleshoot-upn-changes)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that includes the users shown in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783846866870-zb0snk9j.png)  
  
Which users are able to review the Adoption Score in the Microsoft 365 admin center?
questions.explanation:
The Microsoft 365 Adoption Score report is accessible to users in the Reports Reader, Exchange Administrator, and User Experience Success Manager roles. Therefore, all three listed users can review the score.\
\
**Learn more:** [Microsoft Adoption Score report overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/adoption/adoption-score?view=o365-worldwide)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that includes the users shown in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783846866870-zb0snk9j.png)  
  
Which users are able to review the Adoption Score in the Microsoft 365 admin center?

options.text: Edit the settings of the team that contains the channel.
Edit the Locations settings of DLP1.
Modify the licenses assigned to User1.
Edit the policy rules of DLP1.

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Purview DLP rules contain the conditions and actions that govern enforcement. A Teams DLP rule can match sensitive information shared with people outside the organization and apply a blocking action for chat and channel messages. Editing the rule to enforce blocking for external sharing in Teams channels prevents the message from being shared; changing locations, team settings, or the user’s license does not configure that DLP enforcement action.

**Learn more:** [Data loss prevention and Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/dlp-microsoft-teams)

questions.domain: Implement and manage Microsoft Entra identity and access
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
You create a Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence (Defender TI) project called Project1.  
  
You need to add artifacts to Project1.  
  
Which artifact type can you add to Project1?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence projects organize investigation indicators and IOCs. Supported project artifacts include internet infrastructure indicators such as IP addresses, domains, and hosts; therefore, an IP address can be added to a project.\
\
**Learn more:** [Using Projects in Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender/threat-intelligence/using-projects) · [Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender/threat-intelligence/what-is-microsoft-defender-threat-intelligence-defender-ti)

questions.domain: Manage compliance by using Microsoft Purview
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your network includes an on-premises Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) domain. The domain has two organizational units (OUs), named OU1 and OU2, and contains the users shown in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783918989215-78itbubn.png)  
  
You have a Microsoft Entra tenant. You plan to synchronize the domain with the Microsoft Entra tenant by using Microsoft Entra Connect Sync.  
  
You need to ensure that only users in the Sales and Marketing departments synchronize with the tenant. The solution must minimize administrative effort.  
  
What should you configure in Microsoft Entra Connect?
questions.explanation:
Attribute-based filtering can scope synchronization according to each user object's `department` attribute, allowing Sales and Marketing users to synchronize regardless of their OU while excluding Accounts users. This avoids maintaining a separate group and is more precise than domain- or OU-based filtering. Microsoft documents attribute-based filtering as the flexible option for filtering objects by attribute values.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Entra Connect Sync: Configure filtering](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/connect/how-to-connect-sync-configure-filtering)

questions.domain: Implement and manage Microsoft Entra identity and access
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that includes users in the United States, Europe, and Asia.  
  
You use Azure AD Identity Protection.  
  
You have a virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), and all VDI servers are in the United States.  
  
Users access Microsoft 365 from laptops and from the VDI.  
  
Some VDI users report being blocked from signing in to Microsoft 365 because of a high sign-in risk.  
  
You need to reduce the chance that VDI users are incorrectly blocked from signing in to Microsoft 365. The solution must ensure that VDI-environment sign-ins are protected by using Identity Protection.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
A trusted named location containing the VDI environment’s public egress IP addresses improves Microsoft Entra ID Protection’s sign-in-risk calculation and lowers the sign-in risk for authentications from that known network. Identity Protection continues to evaluate those sign-ins, avoiding an exclusion that would remove risk-based protection.

**Learn more:** [Risk detection types and levels - Microsoft Entra ID Protection](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-protection/concept-risk-detection-types) · [Risk policies - Microsoft Entra ID Protection](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-protection/howto-identity-protection-configure-risk-policies)

questions.domain: Deploy and manage a Microsoft 365 tenant
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
You need to make sure that administrators receive an email when Microsoft 365 Defender detects a sign-in from a risky IP address.  
  
What should you create?
questions.explanation:
An incident notification rule sends email to designated recipients when Microsoft Defender XDR creates or updates incidents. questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
You need to make sure that administrators receive an email when Microsoft 365 Defender detects a sign-in from a risky IP address.  
  
What should you create?

options.text: a Microsoft 365 group that has assigned membership
a Microsoft 365 group that has dynamic user membership
a security group that has assigned membership
a security group that has dynamic user membership

questions.explanation:
A security group with assigned membership provides controlled, manually managed membership for assigning the Reports Reader role and granting enterprise-application access. Dynamic membership is not appropriate for the role-assignment requirement represented by this Azure AD scenario.

**Learn more:** [Use Microsoft Entra groups to manage role assignments](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/role-based-access-control/groups-concept) · [Use a group to manage access to SaaS apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/users/groups-saasapps)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 tenant.  
  
You create a retention label named Retention1, as shown in the following exhibit.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783848352103-lmu1r9pq.png)  
  
You apply Retention1 to all Microsoft OneDrive content.  
  
On January 1, 2020, a user saves a file named File1 in OneDrive.  
  
On January 10, 2020, the user modifies File1.  
  
On February 1, 2020, the user deletes File1.  
  
When will File1 be permanently removed and unrecoverable from OneDrive?
questions.explanation:
A retention label configured to retain content for six months and then delete it, with the period based on when the item was created, retains File1 until six months after January 1, 2020. Deleting or modifying the file does not change that creation-date-based retention period, so the file becomes eligible for permanent deletion on July 1, 2020.

**Learn more:** [Learn about retention policies and retention labels](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/retention) · [Configure Microsoft 365 retention settings to automatically retain or delete content](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/retention-settings)

questions.explanation:
Microsoft contacts the configured Global privacy contact for a data breach related to Microsoft Entra services. If no Global privacy contact is configured, Microsoft contacts the tenant’s Global Administrators. User2 is the only Global Administrator.

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
You need to determine which shadow IT apps users connect to by using Cloud Discovery in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps.  
  
What should you create first?
questions.explanation:
A Cloud Discovery snapshot report provides ad-hoc visibility by analyzing manually uploaded firewall or proxy traffic logs. That analysis identifies the cloud apps users access, including shadow IT apps. App discovery policies use discovery data to alert on newly detected apps, rather than performing the initial traffic-log discovery.

**Learn more:** [Cloud app discovery overview - Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-cloud-apps/set-up-cloud-discovery) · [Create cloud discovery policies - Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-cloud-apps/cloud-discovery-policies)

**Learn more:** [Create indicators for IPs and URLs/domains - Microsoft Defender for Endpoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/indicator-ip-domain) · [Create and manage device groups in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/machine-groups)","trackingInfo":{"questionId":"b55db5ee-466a-490b-879d-35ac7150bf78","examProvider":"microsoft","examName":"ms-102","mode":"default"}}]]
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses retention policies.  
  
You apply a preservation lock to a retention policy assigned to all executive users.  
  
Which two actions can you perform on the retention policy after applying the preservation lock? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Extend the duration of the policy.

questions.explanation:
A preservation-locked Microsoft Purview retention policy cannot be disabled, have locations removed, or have its retention period reduced. It can be made more restrictive by adding locations and extending the retention period.

**Learn more:** [Use Preservation Lock to restrict changes to retention policies and retention label policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/retention-preservation-lock)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.  
  
In Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, you enable the **Allow or block file** advanced feature.  
  
You need to prevent users from downloading a file named `File1.exe`.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
A file indicator configured with the Block action is used by Microsoft Defender for Endpoint to block a potentially malicious PE file, including an `.exe`, from being downloaded. The Allow or block file feature is enabled before creating that indicator.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create indicators for files - Microsoft Defender for Endpoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/indicator-file) · [Take response actions on a file in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/respond-file-alerts)

questions.domain: Implement and manage Microsoft Entra identity and access
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.  
  
In Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, you enable the **Allow or block file** advanced feature.  
  
You need to prevent users from downloading a file named `File1.exe`.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra ID Protection automatically adds users actively assigned the Global Administrator, Security Administrator, or Security Reader role to the Users at risk detected alerts list, provided they have a valid email or alternate email address. Security Operator is not included in the automatic notification recipients.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Entra ID Protection notifications](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-protection/howto-identity-protection-configure-notifications)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E3 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Plan 1.  
  
Which two Defender for Endpoint features are available with the subscription? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
> NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Plan 1 provides attack surface reduction capabilities, including controls such as attack surface reduction rules, web protection, network protection, and device control. Defender for Endpoint reporting is also available for Plan 1, including endpoint security reports such as device health, web protection, and attack surface reduction reports.

**Learn more:** [Overview of Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Plan 1](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/defender-endpoint-plan-1) · [Microsoft Defender for Endpoint reports](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/threat-protection-reports)

questions.domain: Manage compliance by using Microsoft Purview
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription with the sensitivity labels published as shown in the following exhibit.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783845953367-xh04ufo8.png)  
  
Which labels can users apply to content?

options.text: Label1, Label3, Label4, and Label6 only
Label1, Label2, Label3, Label4, Label5, and Label6

questions.explanation:
A parent sensitivity label that contains sublabels cannot be applied directly to content. Label2 and Label5 are parent labels, while Label1 is standalone and Label3, Label4, and Label6 are sublabels that users can apply. Microsoft documents that parent labels with sublabels cannot be applied to content.\
\
**Learn more:** [Automatically apply a sensitivity label to Microsoft 365 data](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/apply-sensitivity-label-automatically)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A network contains an Active Directory domain named `adatum.com` that is synchronized with a Microsoft Entra tenant.  
  
The domain has 100 user accounts.  
  
Each user's **city** attribute is set to the city in which that user lives.  
  
You need to change the **city** attribute value to each city's three-letter airport code.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: From Windows PowerShell on a domain controller, run the Get-ADUser and Set-ADUser cmdlets.
From Azure Cloud Shell, run the Get-MgUser and Update-MgUser cmdlets.
From the Microsoft Entra admin center, select all the Microsoft Entra users, and then use the User settings blade.
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, select the users, and then use the Bulk actions option.

questions.explanation:
For Microsoft Entra users synchronized from on-premises Active Directory, the on-premises directory is authoritative for synchronized attributes. The Active Directory `Set-ADUser` cmdlet modifies an AD user and includes the `-City` parameter, while `Get-ADUser` can retrieve multiple user objects for a bulk update pipeline.

**Learn more:** [Get-ADUser (ActiveDirectory)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/activedirectory/get-aduser?view=windowsserver2025-ps) · [Set-ADUser (ActiveDirectory)](https://learn.microsoft.com/ko-kr/powershell/module/activedirectory/set-aduser?preserve-view=true&view=windowsserver2022-ps)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are evaluating the processes required for Project1.  
  
You need to recommend the DNS record that must be created when adding a domain name for the project.  
  
Which DNS record should you recommend?
questions.explanation:
An MX record is used to verify ownership of a Microsoft 365 custom domain when the MX verification method is used, and it is the record type that directs email for the domain to Exchange Online during the mailbox migration. Host A and AAAA records resolve names to IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, while an NS record delegates DNS authority. Microsoft documents MX as an alternative method for custom-domain verification and as the required record type for Microsoft 365 email routing.

**Learn more:** [Add a custom domain to Microsoft 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/setup/add-domain?view=o365-worldwide) · [Add DNS records to connect your domain](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/get-help-with-domains/create-dns-records-at-any-dns-hosting-provider?view=o365-worldwide)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to notify the human resources department manager whenever a user in that department shares a file or folder from the department’s Microsoft SharePoint site.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: From the SharePoint admin center, modify the sharing settings.
From the SharePoint site, create an alert.
From the Microsoft Purview compliance portal, create a data loss prevention (DLP) policy.
From the Microsoft 365 Defender portal, create an alert policy.

questions.explanation:
An alert policy can detect the SharePoint activity **Shared file, folder, or site**, scope the policy to the relevant users and site, and email the designated manager when the activity occurs. SharePoint sharing settings control sharing permissions, while DLP policies are intended to detect and protect sensitive content rather than provide general sharing-event notifications.

**Learn more:** [Audit log activities](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/audit-log-activities) · [Use sharing auditing in the audit log](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/audit-log-sharing)

questions.domain: Implement and manage Microsoft Entra identity and access
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company has a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
You onboard a device on the company network to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.  
  
In the Microsoft 365 Defender portal, you see that the device inventory contains many devices with an **Onboarding status** of **Can be onboarded**.  
  
You need to ensure that onboarded devices do not poll the network for device discovery, while still allowing them to discover devices with which they communicate directly.  
  
What should you configure in the Microsoft 365 Defender portal?
questions.explanation:
Basic discovery passively observes network traffic to identify devices that communicate with onboarded endpoints; it does not actively scan or probe the network. This preserves discovery of directly communicating devices without network polling.

**Learn more:** [Manage device discovery in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/configure-device-discovery) · [Microsoft Defender for Endpoint device discovery overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/device-discovery)

questions.domain: Manage compliance by using Microsoft Purview
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 tenant.  
  
The tenant’s Microsoft Secure Score is shown in the following exhibit.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783849429164-46hptqeu.png)  
  
You plan to enable Security defaults for Azure AD.  
  
Which three improvement actions will this affect?  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Ensure all users can complete multi-factor authentication for secure access
Enable policy to block legacy authentication

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra security defaults enforces MFA for administrators, requires all users to register for and be able to complete MFA, and blocks legacy authentication protocols. Microsoft Secure Score awards full points for the corresponding three improvement actions when security defaults is enabled.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Secure Score — Security defaults](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/security/defender/microsoft-secure-score?view=o365-worldwide) · [Security defaults in Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/fundamentals/security-defaults)

questions.domain: Manage compliance by using Microsoft Purview
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.  
  
All devices in your organization are onboarded to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.  
  
You need to ensure that an alert is generated when malicious activity has been detected on a device during the previous 24 hours.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: From the Microsoft Defender portal, create an alert suppression rule and assign an alert.
From the Microsoft Purview compliance portal, create an audit log search.
From the Microsoft Purview compliance portal, create a data loss prevention (DLP) policy.
From the Microsoft Defender portal, create an Advanced hunting query and a detection rule.

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender custom detection rules are based on Advanced hunting queries and can run on a schedule to generate alerts when matching device activity is found. An Advanced hunting query can scope its results to malicious activity from the last 24 hours, and the associated detection rule generates the alert.

**Learn more:** [Overview of custom detections in Microsoft Defender XDR](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/custom-detections-overview) · [Proactively hunt for threats with advanced hunting in Microsoft Defender](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/advanced-hunting-overview)

questions.domain: Implement and manage Microsoft Entra identity and access
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an Azure AD tenant containing the users shown in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783846882841-mzo2fh4e.png)  
  
You need to compare the permissions for each role while minimizing administrative effort.  
  
Which portal should you use?
questions.explanation:
User Administrator, Password Administrator, and Exchange Administrator are Microsoft Entra built-in roles. The Microsoft Entra admin center lets administrators list built-in and custom role definitions and view their permissions, enabling a direct comparison of these roles.

**Learn more:** [List Microsoft Entra role definitions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/role-based-access-control/role-definitions-list) · [Microsoft Entra built-in roles](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/role-based-access-control/permissions-reference)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription and use Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps.  
  
You are reviewing the subscription's activity log.  
  
You need to ensure that events that originate from the on-premises network are automatically categorized as **Administrative**.  
  
What should you create?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps uses IP address ranges to categorize activities from known networks. Creating an IP address range for the on-premises network and assigning it the **Administrative** category causes activities from those IP addresses to be categorized accordingly in the activity log.\
\
**Learn more:** [Work with IP ranges and tags - Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-cloud-apps/ip-tags)

questions.domain: Deploy and manage a Microsoft 365 tenant
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that contains the identities shown in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783895943587-lhzic15g.png)  
  
You create a shared mailbox named Shared1.  
  
Which identities can you add as members of Shared1?
questions.explanation:
Shared-mailbox Full Access can be assigned to user mailboxes and mail-enabled security groups. Therefore, User1 and Group2 can be granted membership/access to Shared1; a Microsoft 365 group and a distribution group cannot be used for that access permission.

**Learn more:** [Manage permissions for recipients in Exchange Online](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/exchange/recipients-in-exchange-online/manage-permissions-for-recipients) · [Create shared mailboxes in the Exchange admin center](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/exchange/collaboration/shared-mailboxes/create-shared-mailboxes)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your network includes an on-premises Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) forest.  
  
You have a Microsoft Entra tenant.  
  
You implement Microsoft Entra Connect Sync.  
  
Synchronization does not complete.  
  
After reviewing the logs, you find the following error message: "We found an issue with the service account that is used to run Microsoft Entra Connect Sync".  
  
You need to ensure that synchronization completes successfully. The solution must minimize administrative effort.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: From the Microsoft Entra admin center, reset the password of the Microsoft Entra Connect Sync account.
From PowerShell, run the Repair-AADCloudSyncToolsAccount cmdlet.
From Active Directory Users and Computers, reset the password or the ADSync service account.
From PowerShell, run the Set-ADSyncScheduler cmdlet.

questions.explanation:
`Repair-AADCloudSyncToolsAccount` repairs the Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync service account by resetting its synchronization-account authentication with a new account in Microsoft Entra ID. Microsoft specifically prescribes this cmdlet for the service-account error, making it the direct, low-effort remediation.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync error codes and descriptions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/cloud-sync/reference-error-codes) · [Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync troubleshooting](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/cloud-sync/how-to-troubleshoot)

questions.domain: Manage compliance by using Microsoft Purview
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that includes Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Defender XDR.  
  
All users use devices running Windows 11.  
  
In the Microsoft Defender portal, you review the Microsoft Secure Score recommendations. One of the leading recommendations is to block all Microsoft Office applications from creating child processes.  
  
You need to raise the secure score by remediating the recommendation.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Select Safe Documents for Office clients.
Create a policy for Office applications.
Configure an endpoint detection and response (EDR) policy.
Create an attack surface reduction (ASR) policy.

questions.explanation:
The “Block all Office applications from creating child processes” control is a Microsoft Defender Attack Surface Reduction rule. Deploying it in block mode through an ASR policy prevents Office applications from launching child processes and addresses the corresponding Secure Score recommendation.

**Learn more:** [Attack surface reduction rules reference - Microsoft Defender for Endpoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/attack-surface-reduction-rules-reference) · [Attack surface reduction rules deployment overview - Microsoft Defender for Endpoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/attack-surface-reduction-rules-deployment)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription and use Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.  
  
You integrate Microsoft Defender for Endpoint with Microsoft Intune.  
  
In Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, you review the top security recommendations and find a recommendation to update Microsoft Edge (Chromium) to a newer version.  
  
You need to ensure that a security task is created in Intune to address the recommendation.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: From the Microsoft Intune admin center, configure Windows Autopatch.
From the Microsoft Intune admin center, configure a security baseline.
From the Microsoft Defender portal, select Request remediation.
From the Microsoft Defender portal add an incident notification rule.

questions.explanation:
The Microsoft Defender portal's **Request remediation** workflow submits a remediation request for a vulnerability-management security recommendation. With the Intune connection enabled, it creates a security task and remediation ticket in Microsoft Intune for the requested software update.

**Learn more:** [Remediate vulnerabilities with Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-vulnerability-management/tvm-remediation)
