Your network includes an on-premises Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) domain. The domain has 2.000 user accounts.  
  
You have a Microsoft Entra tenant.  
  
You need to synchronize the domain with the Microsoft Entra tenant. The solution must satisfy the following requirements:  
  
- Minimize infrastructure requirements.  
- Minimize single points of failure.  
- Minimize administrative effort.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync uses a lightweight, cloud-managed provisioning-agent model to synchronize AD DS identities with Microsoft Entra ID. Multiple active agents can provide automatic failover, reducing single points of failure, while cloud-managed configuration and monitoring reduce on-premises infrastructure and administrative overhead. [Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/cloud-sync/what-is-cloud-sync)

**Learn more:** [What is Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync?](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/cloud-sync/what-is-cloud-sync)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your network has an on-premises Active Directory domain named `contoso.com`. The domain includes 1,000 Windows 10 devices.  
  
You complete a proof-of-concept (PoC) deployment of Microsoft Defender for Endpoint for 10 test devices. During onboarding, you configure Microsoft Defender for Endpoint-related data to be stored in the United States.  
  
You plan to onboard every device to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.  
  
You need Microsoft Defender for Endpoint data to be stored in Europe.  
  
What should you do first?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint data storage is set during tenant provisioning and cannot be changed in place. The existing onboarded test devices must be offboarded before the tenant can be reset and configured for the required European data location. Creating or deleting a workspace does not change the Defender for Endpoint tenant’s data location.

**Learn more:** [Onboard servers through Microsoft Defender for Endpoint's onboarding experience](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/onboard-server) · [Microsoft Defender for Endpoint data storage and privacy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/data-storage-privacy)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your network includes an Active Directory domain and an Azure AD tenant.  
  
The network uses a firewall that has a list of permitted outbound domains.  
  
You start implementing directory synchronization.  
  
You find that the firewall configuration includes only these domain names in its allowed-domains list:  
  
- `*.microsoft.com`  
- `*.office.com`  
  
Directory synchronization fails.  
  
You need to make sure that directory synchronization completes successfully.  
  
What is the best way to accomplish this goal? More than one answer choice may accomplish the goal. Select the **BEST** answer.

options.text: From the firewall, modify the list of allowed outbound domains.
From Azure AD Connect, modify the Customize synchronization options task.
From the firewall, create a list of allowed inbound domains.
Deploy an Azure AD Connect sync server in staging mode.
From the firewall, allow the IP address range of the Azure data center for outbound communication.

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra Connect requires outbound connectivity to the documented Microsoft Entra and Microsoft 365 endpoints. An allowlist limited to `*.microsoft.com` and `*.office.com` omits required endpoints, so the firewall’s outbound domain allowlist must be updated to permit them.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Entra Connect: Prerequisites and hardware](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/connect/how-to-connect-install-prerequisites)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint integrated with Microsoft Intune.  
  
Devices are enrolled in Microsoft Intune and onboarded by using Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.  
  
You plan to block devices according to the machine risk score calculated by Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.  
  
What should you create first?

options.text: an endpoint detection and response policy

questions.explanation:
A device compliance policy includes the Microsoft Defender for Endpoint setting that requires a device to be at or below a selected machine risk score. Devices exceeding that threshold are marked noncompliant, allowing Conditional Access to block their access to corporate resources.

**Learn more:** [Configure Microsoft Defender for Endpoint with Intune and onboard devices](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/device-security/microsoft-defender/configure-integration) · [Windows compliance settings in Microsoft Intune](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/device-security/compliance/ref-windows-settings)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender for Office 365 and includes a mailbox named Mailbox1.  
  
You plan to use Mailbox1 to collect and analyze unfiltered email messages.  
  
You need to ensure that Defender for Office 365 takes no action on any inbound email delivered to Mailbox1.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Configure a retention policy for Mailbox1.
Configure Mailbox1 as a SecOps mailbox.
Place a litigation hold on Mailbox1.

questions.explanation:
A SecOps mailbox is a dedicated mailbox for collecting and analyzing unfiltered good and malicious messages. When it is configured in the advanced delivery policy, Microsoft 365 filters take no action on those inbound messages; malware filtering is also bypassed for SecOps mailboxes. Retention policies and litigation holds preserve content but do not alter email filtering, and mail flow rules cannot bypass all relevant protection.

**Learn more:** [Configure advanced delivery policy for SecOps mailboxes](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/advanced-delivery-policy-configure) · [Anti-malware protection FAQ](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/anti-malware-protection-faq)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
You need to receive an alert when Microsoft Defender XDR identifies high-severity incidents.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
A notification rule can send email notifications for new Microsoft Defender XDR incidents and can be configured to trigger for High alert severity.\
\
**Learn more:** [Get incident notifications by email - Microsoft Defender XDR](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/m365d-notifications-incidents)

questions.domain: Implement and manage Microsoft Entra identity and access
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
You need to receive an alert when Microsoft Defender XDR identifies high-severity incidents.  
  
What should you use?

options.text: Configure the Safe Links global settings.
Configure the Safe Attachments global settings.

questions.explanation:
Safe Attachments global settings enable Defender for Office 365 protection for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams, where malicious files are detected and blocked from being opened. To completely block downloading detected malicious files, the SharePoint Online tenant setting `DisallowInfectedFileDownload` must also be enabled; Safe Attachments is the applicable Defender feature among the available choices.

**Learn more:** [Turn on Safe Attachments for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/safe-attachments-for-spo-odfb-teams-configure) · [Safe Attachments for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/safe-attachments-for-spo-odfb-teams-about)

questions.domain: Manage compliance by using Microsoft Purview
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
Your company assigns a customer ID to every customer. The customer IDs contain 10 numbers followed by 10 characters. The following is an example customer ID: `12-456-7890-abc-de-fghij`.  
  
You plan to create a data loss prevention (DLP) policy that detects messages containing customer IDs.  
  
What should you create so that the DLP policy can detect the customer IDs?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Purview DLP uses sensitive information types to detect sensitive content. A custom sensitive information type can define the organization’s customer-ID pattern by using a regular expression and can be included in a DLP policy.

Microsoft Entra ID uses the user principal name (UPN) as the sign-in name. questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra ID uses the user principal name (UPN) for sign-in, and a synchronized UPN suffix must correspond to a verified tenant domain. An unverified on-premises suffix is replaced with the tenant’s `.onmicrosoft.com` suffix during synchronization. The **Allow log on locally** right only permits local interactive logon to a computer; it does not change User2’s cloud UPN or validate the `fabrikam.com` domain.

Does this solution meet the goal?

A verified custom domain that matches an on-premises UPN suffix allows Microsoft Entra Connect to synchronize that suffix as the user’s Microsoft Entra UPN. Users sign in to Microsoft Entra ID using their UPN, and pass-through authentication can validate the synchronized user’s on-premises credentials. You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
You plan to configure Privileged Identity Management (PIM) for the User Administrator role in Microsoft Entra.  
  
You need to ensure that a user can submit a role-assignment request for the User Administrator role only during the next six months.  
  
How should you configure the assignment?

options.text: Set Allow permanent active to assignment Yes.
Set Allow permanent eligible assignment to Yes.

questions.explanation:
An eligible Microsoft Entra PIM assignment requires the user to activate the role by making a request, while an active assignment grants its privileges without that action. A time-bound eligible assignment with an end date six months ahead limits the period during which the user can request activation; permanent assignment settings would not impose that six-month limit.

**Learn more:** [Assign Microsoft Entra roles in Privileged Identity Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-governance/privileged-identity-management/pim-how-to-add-role-to-user)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
You need to receive notifications at your personal email address when a Microsoft Exchange Online service issue occurs.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: From the Exchange admin center, create a contact.
From the Microsoft Outlook client, configure an Inbox rule.
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, update the technical contact details.
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, customize the Service health settings.

questions.explanation:
Microsoft 365 Service health settings let an administrator configure email notifications for incidents and advisories, choose the services to monitor (including Exchange Online), and specify up to two email addresses for notification delivery.\
\
**Learn more:** [How to check Microsoft 365 service health](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/view-service-health?view=o365-worldwide)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription and the retention policies shown in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783845857333-40lu7am7.png)  
  
Both policies apply to a Microsoft SharePoint site named Site1, which contains a file named File1.docx. File1.docx was created on January 1, 2022, and was last modified on January 31, 2022. The file was **not** modified again.  
  
When will File1.docx be deleted automatically?
questions.explanation:
When multiple retention policies apply, retention takes precedence over permanent deletion and the longest retention period for the item wins. The two-year retention based on the file's January 31, 2022 last-modified date ends on January 31, 2024. The one-year policy's automatic deletion action is suspended while that longer retention period applies, so the file is deleted when the longer retention expires.

**Learn more:** [Learn about retention policies and retention labels](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/retention)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Endpoint security.  
  
You need to create a group and assign the Endpoint Security Manager role to that group.  
  
Which group type can you use?

options.text: mail-enabled security, Microsoft 365, and security only
distribution, mail-enabled security, Microsoft 365, and security

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Intune uses Microsoft Entra security-enabled groups for administrative role assignments. The built-in Endpoint Security Manager role should be assigned to a manually managed security group; Microsoft 365 and distribution group types do not meet Intune’s security-group requirement.

**Learn more:** [Use groups to organize users and devices for Microsoft Intune](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/fundamentals/tenant-administration/add-groups) · [Role-based access control (RBAC) with Microsoft Intune](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/fundamentals/role-based-access-control/overview)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
You are creating a data loss prevention (DLP) policy that applies to the locations shown in the following exhibit.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783867481125-tb22vkl7.png)  
  
Which condition can be used in the policy's DLP rules?
questions.explanation:
Sensitive information types are supported as DLP rule conditions across Exchange email, SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, Teams chat and channel messages, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps instances, and on-premises repositories. When a policy includes Teams chat and channel messages, sensitivity labels cannot be used as the content-definition condition because that location does not support them. Content search queries are used by eDiscovery, not DLP rules.

**Learn more:** [Data Loss Prevention policy reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/dlp-policy-reference)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],The network includes an on-premises Active Directory domain named contoso.local, which has five domain controllers.  
  
The company purchases Microsoft 365 and creates an Azure AD tenant named contoso.onmicrosoft.com.  
  
You intend to install Azure AD Connect on a member server and implement pass-through authentication.  
  
You need to prepare the environment for the planned pass-through authentication implementation.  
  
Which three actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: From a domain controller, install an Authentication Agent.
From the Microsoft Entra admin center, configure an authentication method.
From Active Directory Domains and Trusts, add a UPN suffix.
Modify the email address attribute for each user account.
From the Microsoft Entra admin center, add a custom domain name.
Modify the User logon name for each user account.

questions.explanation:
For synchronized users to sign in with pass-through authentication, their on-premises Active Directory userPrincipalName values must map to a verified custom domain in Microsoft Entra ID. Because contoso.local is nonroutable and cannot be verified as a tenant domain, add a routable UPN suffix in AD DS, add and verify the matching custom domain in the tenant, and update each user’s User logon name to use that suffix. Otherwise, synchronization replaces the unsupported suffix with the default .onmicrosoft.com suffix.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Entra Connect: User sign-in](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/connect/plan-connect-user-signin) · [Plan and troubleshoot User Principal Name changes in Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/connect/howto-troubleshoot-upn-changes)

![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783895942305-tnpyxmne.png)  
  
You plan to use Microsoft 365 Backup.  
  
Which users can enable Microsoft 365 Backup?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft 365 Backup can be set up by a Global Administrator or a SharePoint Administrator. Therefore, Admin1 and Admin3 have the required roles; Exchange Administrator and Compliance Administrator do not.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set up Microsoft 365 Backup](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/backup/backup-setup?view=o365-worldwide)

the Licenses blade in the Microsoft Entra admin center
Reports in the Microsoft 365 admin center

questions.explanation:
The Licenses blade in the Microsoft Entra admin center provides license-assignment details, including whether a license is inherited through group-based licensing and the group responsible for that assignment. Microsoft Entra group licensing automatically assigns licenses when users join a licensed group.

**Learn more:** [Users, groups, licensing, and roles in Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/users/directory-overview-user-model) · [Assign or unassign licenses to a group in the Microsoft 365 admin center](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/manage/manage-group-licenses?view=o365-worldwide)

The network contains an Active Directory domain named `adatum.com` that synchronizes with Azure AD.  
  
The domain has 100 user accounts. Each user's `city` attribute is set to the city in which that user resides.  
  
You need to change the `city` attribute value to the three-letter airport code for each city.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: From Windows PowerShell on a domain controller, run the Get-ADUser and Set-ADUser cmdlets.
From Azure Cloud Shell, run the Get-ADUser and Set-ADUser cmdlets.
From Windows PowerShell on a domain controller, run the Get-MgUser and Update-MgUser cmdlets.
From Azure Cloud Shell, run the Get-MgUser and Update-MgUser cmdlets.

questions.explanation:
For user attributes synchronized from on-premises Active Directory, the on-premises directory is the authoritative source. `Get-ADUser` can retrieve the domain user objects, and `Set-ADUser` can update their Active Directory attributes; Azure Cloud Shell Microsoft Graph cmdlets operate against the cloud directory rather than the on-premises AD source.

**Learn more:** [Set-ADUser (ActiveDirectory)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/activedirectory/set-aduser?view=windowsserver2025-ps) · [Get-ADUser (ActiveDirectory)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/activedirectory/get-aduser?view=windowsserver2025-ps)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that contains users with the following device types:  
  
- Windows 10  
- Android  
- iOS  
  
On which devices can you configure Endpoint DLP policies?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP applies to supported onboarded desktop endpoints, including Windows 10. Android and iOS are not supported Endpoint DLP platforms, so only the Windows 10 devices listed can use these policies.\
\
**Learn more:** [Get started with endpoint data loss prevention](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/endpoint-dlp-getting-started) · [Microsoft Purview service description](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/office365/servicedescriptions/microsoft-365-service-descriptions/microsoft-365-tenantlevel-services-licensing-guidance/microsoft-purview-service-description)

questions.domain: Deploy and manage a Microsoft 365 tenant
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
You plan to deploy Microsoft Purview Privileged Access Management.  
  
Which Microsoft Office 365 workloads support privileged access?

options.text: Microsoft Exchange Online and SharePoint Online only
Microsoft Teams and SharePoint Online only
Microsoft Teams, Exchange Online, and SharePoint Online

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Purview Privileged Access Management provides just-in-time approval for privileged Exchange Online tasks. Its supported policy scope is Exchange; Microsoft Teams and SharePoint Online are not supported workloads for this capability.\
\
**Learn more:** [Learn about privileged access management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/privileged-access-management) · [Get started with privileged access management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/privileged-access-management-configuration)

questions.domain: Implement and manage Microsoft Entra identity and access
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
You plan to deploy Microsoft Purview Privileged Access Management.  
  
Which Microsoft Office 365 workloads support privileged access?

options.text: a security group that has assigned membership
a Microsoft 365 group that has dynamic user membership
a security group that has dynamic user membership

questions.explanation:
A Microsoft Entra role assigned through a group requires a role-assignable security group. Role-assignable groups must use assigned membership and cannot use dynamic membership. The same assigned security group can also be assigned to an enterprise application for access.

**Learn more:** [Use Microsoft Entra groups to manage role assignments](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/role-based-access-control/groups-concept) · [Manage users and groups assignment to an application](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/enterprise-apps/assign-user-or-group-access-portal)

questions.domain: Manage compliance by using Microsoft Purview
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
From the Microsoft 365 Defender portal, you intend to export a detailed report of compromised users. What is the maximum time range that can be included in that report?
questions.explanation:
In the Microsoft Defender portal, the Compromised users report exposes two views: the aggregate (Summary) view has data for the last 90 days, while the detail view has data for only the last 30 days. Because the question asks about exporting a detailed report of compromised users, the maximum time range available for the Details data is 30 days. The 90-day figure (D) applies to the aggregate/summary view, not the detailed export, so it is a distractor here.\
\
**Learn more:** [View email security reports – Compromised users report](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/reports-email-security)

Microsoft 365 custom-domain setup requires domain-ownership verification. Although TXT is the preferred verification record, Microsoft 365 also supports a temporary MX record for verification. Of the available record types, only an MX record fulfills that requirement. Setting the verification MX record to a high priority value prevents it from affecting the existing mail-routing configuration during the pilot.

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
You plan to use Microsoft Entra ID Protection.  
  
You need to ensure that account passwords are changed when account credentials are leaked.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
A user risk policy evaluates the risk that a user account is compromised, including leaked-credential detections. It can require risk remediation or a secure password change for high-risk users, preventing access until the password is changed.\
\
**Learn more:** [Microsoft Entra ID Protection risk-based access policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-protection/concept-identity-protection-policies) · [Risk policies - Microsoft Entra ID Protection](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-protection/howto-identity-protection-configure-risk-policies)

Your network includes an Active Directory domain.  
  
You have an Azure AD tenant with Security defaults disabled.  
  
Azure AD Connect is configured for directory synchronization. Password hash synchronization and pass-through authentication are disabled.  
  
You need to enable Azure AD Identity Protection to detect leaked credentials.  
  
What should you do first?

options.text: From Azure AD Connect, enable password hash synchronization.
From the Microsoft Entra admin center, enable Security defaults.
From the Microsoft Entra admin center, configure verifiable credentials.
From Azure AD Connect, enable pass-through authentication.

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra ID Protection’s leaked-credentials detection requires password hash synchronization for hybrid users so it can compare discovered credentials with the users’ current synchronized password hashes. Pass-through authentication, Security defaults, and verifiable credentials do not satisfy this prerequisite.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Entra ID Protection FAQ](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-protection/id-protection-faq) · [What are risk detections? - Microsoft Entra ID Protection](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-protection/concept-identity-protection-risks)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 tenant.  
  
You intend to manage tenant incidents by using Microsoft Defender XDR.  
  
Which Microsoft service source appears on the **Incidents** page in the Microsoft Defender portal?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps is an integrated Microsoft Defender XDR workload. Its alerts are included and correlated in the Defender portal incident queue, where it is available as a service/detection source.\
\
**Learn more:** [Prioritize incidents in the Microsoft Defender portal](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-in/defender-xdr/incident-queue) · [List incidents API in Microsoft Defender XDR](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/api-list-incidents)

questions.domain: Deploy and manage a Microsoft 365 tenant
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 tenant.  
  
You intend to manage tenant incidents by using Microsoft Defender XDR.  
  
Which Microsoft service source appears on the **Incidents** page in the Microsoft Defender portal?
questions.explanation:
When Microsoft Defender for Endpoint RBAC is enabled, users with read-only Microsoft Entra roles such as Security Reader lose portal access until they are assigned a Defender for Endpoint role. Security Administrators are automatically assigned the default Defender for Endpoint administrator role when RBAC is enabled, which provides the required portal access to view security incidents.

**Learn more:** [Overview of permissions management - Microsoft Defender for Endpoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/assign-portal-access) · [Microsoft Entra built-in roles](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/role-based-access-control/permissions-reference)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription and use Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps.  
  
You register a cloud app called App1 in Microsoft Entra ID.  
  
You need to create an access policy for App1.  
  
What should you do first?

options.text: Deploy Conditional Access App Control to App1.
Create an app tag for App1.
Add a security information and event management (SIEM) agent to Defender for Cloud Apps.
Configure an app connector to Defender for Cloud Apps.

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps access policies rely on Conditional Access App Control to monitor and control user access to cloud apps in real time. App connectors provide API-based controls and are not required for this type of policy.

**Learn more:** [Create Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps access policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-cloud-apps/access-policy-aad) · [Use Defender for Cloud Apps Conditional Access app control](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-cloud-apps/conditional-access-app-control-how-to-overview)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 tenant.  
  
You create an auto-labeling policy that encrypts emails containing a sensitive info type. You specify the locations to which the policy will apply.  
  
You need to deploy the policy.  
  
What should you do first?

options.text: Run the policy in simulation mode.
Turn on co-authoring for files with sensitivity labels.
Review the sensitive information in Activity explorer.

questions.explanation:
An auto-labeling policy for sensitivity labels should initially run in simulation mode so that matching email can be evaluated without applying labels or encryption. After the simulation results are reviewed and any necessary refinements are made, the policy can be turned on for production.

**Learn more:** [Automatically apply a sensitivity label to Microsoft 365 data](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/microsoft-365/compliance/apply-sensitivity-label-automatically?view=o365-worldwide) · [Learn about the default sensitivity labels and policies to protect your data](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/default-sensitivity-labels-policies)

questions.domain: Deploy and manage a Microsoft 365 tenant
questions.question:
You have two Microsoft 365 tenants, and users have accounts in both tenants.  
  
You plan to deploy one device to every user. Each device will have the Microsoft Authenticator app installed.  
  
You need to ensure users can use their device for passwordless authentication to both tenants.  
  
Which platform should you provide?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Authenticator supports passwordless phone sign-in for multiple accounts on supported Android and iOS devices. The accounts can belong to the same tenant or to different Microsoft Entra tenants, provided the device is registered with each tenant. Therefore, both iOS and Android satisfy the requirement; a single-answer selection is ambiguous.\
\
**Learn more:** [Enable passwordless sign-in with Authenticator](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory/authentication/howto-authentication-passwordless-phone)

questions.domain: Implement and manage Microsoft Entra identity and access
questions.question:
You have two Microsoft 365 tenants, and users have accounts in both tenants.  
  
You plan to deploy one device to every user. Each device will have the Microsoft Authenticator app installed.  
  
You need to ensure users can use their device for passwordless authentication to both tenants.  
  
Which platform should you provide?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint provides vulnerability management recommendations. An Endpoint Detection and Response policy centrally onboards Intune-managed Windows devices to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, enabling their security and vulnerability data to be collected and reviewed with minimal administrative overhead.

**Learn more:** [Manage endpoint security policies in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/manage-security-policies) · [Manage endpoint security in Intune](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/device-security/endpoint-security-policies)

You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
Conditional Access is configured to block high-risk sign-ins for every user. All users are located in France and are registered for multi-factor authentication (MFA).  
  
Users in the media department will travel to several countries during the next month. You need to ensure that, if media department users are blocked from signing in while travelling, they can remediate the issue without administrator involvement.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Self-service password reset (SSPR) enables users to reset their own credentials without administrator or help-desk intervention, providing a self-service remediation path for a risky identity. MFA registration is already satisfied, while named locations and exclusion groups change Conditional Access targeting rather than enable user remediation.

**Learn more:** [User self-remediation with Microsoft Entra ID Protection](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-protection/concept-identity-protection-user-experience) · [Enable users to unlock their account or reset passwords using Microsoft Entra self-service password reset](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/tutorial-enable-sspr)

You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that includes a user named User1.  
  
User1 has exceeded the default daily limit for permitted email messages and appears on the Restricted entities list.  
  
You need to remove User1 from the Restricted entities list.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:

You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
Users access Microsoft 365 from both their laptops and a corporate Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) solution.  
  
In Microsoft Entra ID Protection, you enable a sign-in risk policy.  
  
Users report that, when using the VDI solution, they are regularly blocked while attempting to access Microsoft 365.  
  
What should you configure?

options.text: the Tenant restrictions settings in Microsoft Entra ID

questions.explanation:
A trusted named location identifies the corporate VDI solution’s outbound IP address ranges as trusted. Microsoft Entra ID Protection uses trusted network locations in some risk detections to reduce false positives, lowering sign-in risk for authentications from that location and preventing unnecessary blocks from the sign-in risk policy.

**Learn more:** [Configure and enable risk policies — Microsoft Entra ID Protection](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-protection/howto-identity-protection-configure-risk-policies) · [Risk detection types and levels — Microsoft Entra ID Protection](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-protection/concept-risk-detection-types)

You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription and onboard all devices to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.  
  
You need to use Defender for Endpoint to block access to the malicious website `www.contoso.com`.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer is part of the solution.  
  
> NOTE: Each correct answer is worth one point.

options.text: Create a web content filtering policy.

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint blocks an organization-specific malicious URL or domain through a custom network indicator. The Custom network indicators feature must be enabled, and a URL/domain indicator must be created with a block action. The indicator configuration can include its scope of enforcement.

**Learn more:** [Create indicators for IPs and URLs/domains - Microsoft Defender for Endpoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/indicator-ip-domain)

You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Microsoft Intune.  
  
You need to access service health alerts from a mobile phone.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
The Microsoft 365 Admin mobile app lets Microsoft 365 administrators view Service health and receive push notifications about service-health updates, incidents, and advisories.\
\
**Learn more:** [About the Microsoft 365 admin mobile app](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/admin-overview/admin-mobile-app?view=o365-worldwide) · [How to check Microsoft 365 service health](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/view-service-health?view=o365-worldwide)

You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
You add a domain named contoso.com.  
  
When you try to verify the domain, you are prompted to send a verification email to [email protected].  
  
You need to change the email address used to verify the domain.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Add a TXT record to the DNS zone of the domain.
From the domain registrar, modify the contact information of the domain.
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, change the global administrator of the Microsoft 365 subscription.
Modify the NS records for the domain.

questions.explanation: Email-based domain verification uses the contact email registered for the domain. Updating the domain’s contact information at its registrar changes the email address available for that verification method.

You have a Microsoft 365 tenant.  
  
You plan to manage tenant incidents by using Microsoft Defender XDR.  
  
Which Microsoft service source will be displayed on the Incidents page in the Microsoft Defender portal?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender XDR correlates alerts from Microsoft Defender security solutions into unified incidents. Microsoft Defender for Identity is a supported alert service source and can be filtered on the incident and alert experiences in the Microsoft Defender portal.\
\
**Learn more:** [List incidents API in Microsoft Defender XDR](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/api-list-incidents) · [How do I investigate and respond using Microsoft Defender XDR?](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/pilot-deploy-investigate-respond)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription and use Microsoft Defender for Office 365.  
  
You need to create a policy that quarantines messages containing attachments with the `.apk` and `.appx` extensions.  
  
Which policy type should you configure?
questions.explanation:
An anti-malware policy provides the common attachments filter, which lets administrators specify file types such as `apk` and `appx`, treats those attachments as malware, and can quarantine the associated messages.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure anti-malware policies for email](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/anti-malware-policies-configure) · [Anti-malware protection for email in Microsoft 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/anti-malware-protection-about)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that includes Windows 11 devices.  
  
All devices are onboarded to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.  
  
You need to compare the devices’ configurations with industry-standard benchmarks.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
Security baselines assessment evaluates endpoint configuration settings against industry security benchmarks. It supports CIS benchmarks for Windows 11, enabling comparison of device configurations with the selected benchmark.\
\
**Learn more:** [Security baselines assessment - Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-vulnerability-management/tvm-security-baselines)

You have a Microsoft 365 tenant.  
  
You intend to manage incidents in the tenant by using Microsoft 365 Defender.  
  
Which Microsoft service source will be displayed on the Microsoft 365 Defender portal's **Incidents** page?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Identity supplies identity-threat alerts that Microsoft Defender XDR correlates into incidents. Its alerts therefore appear with Microsoft Defender for Identity as a service source on the Incidents page.\
\
**Learn more:** [List incidents API in Microsoft Defender XDR](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/api-list-incidents) · [Microsoft Defender XDR in the Microsoft Defender portal](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/microsoft-365-defender-portal)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription and use Microsoft Defender for Office 365.  
  
You need to implement a social-engineering awareness solution that meets these requirements:  
  
- To reset a user's password, simulate an email message that includes a link.  
- Track all users who select the link in the email message.  
- Recommend additional social-engineering training.  
  
What should you use in the Microsoft Defender portal?
questions.explanation:
Attack simulation training provides benign social-engineering simulations, including Credential Harvest email payloads with links, and records individual users who click the simulated message link. It also supports targeted training assignments and recommendations to improve users’ awareness after a simulation.

You plan to deploy Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps and connect Microsoft 365 to Defender for Cloud Apps.  
  
You need to ensure that all Microsoft 365 components can be enabled when you add the app connector.  
  
What should you do first?

options.text: Enable file monitoring for Defender for Cloud Apps.
Add an API token to Defender for Cloud Apps.

You need to recommend a solution for educating users about topics related to social-engineering risks. Users must receive a weekly reminder to complete a learning task.  
  
What should you use in the Microsoft Defender portal?

Attack simulation training measures and manages social-engineering risk and provides direct user training through training campaigns. Its training reminder notifications support a weekly frequency for required learning, satisfying both the education and weekly-reminder requirements.

Your network includes an Active Directory domain called `adatum.com` that is synchronized with Azure AD.  
  
The domain has 100 user accounts.  
  
For every user, the `city` attribute is set to the city in which that user lives.  
  
You need to change the `city` attribute value to each city’s three-letter airport code.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: From Windows PowerShell on a domain controller, run the Get-ADUser and Set-ADUser cmdlets.
From Azure Cloud Shell, run the Get-ADUser and Set-ADUser cmdlets.
From Windows PowerShell on a domain controller, run the Get-MgUser and Update-MgUser cmdlets.
From the Azure portal, select all the Azure AD users, and then use the User settings blade.

questions.explanation:
For synchronized identities, the on-premises Active Directory attribute is the authoritative source for the city value. The ActiveDirectory module’s `Get-ADUser` cmdlet retrieves AD user objects, and `Set-ADUser` updates their properties; running these cmdlets from a domain controller can modify the domain users before Azure AD synchronization publishes the changes.

**Learn more:** [Get-ADUser (ActiveDirectory)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/activedirectory/get-aduser?view=windowsserver2025-ps) · [Set-ADUser (ActiveDirectory)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/activedirectory/set-aduser?view=windowsserver2025-ps)

You need to compare your company’s security configurations with Microsoft best practices and review improvement actions to enhance its security posture.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
A retention label configured to retain content for six months based on the date it was created retains File1 until six months after January 1, 2020. Deleting or modifying the file does not reset a retention period that is based on its creation date. The configured delete action removes the retained file when that period ends.

![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783867453113-461clttt.png)  
  
You plan to create an Endpoint security policy using the **Defender Update controls** template.  
  
To which devices can you apply the policy?
questions.explanation:
The Defender Update controls profile is supported for Windows devices. Device1 runs Windows 11, whereas Device2 runs Linux and Device3 runs macOS, so only Device1 can receive this policy.\
\
**Learn more:** [Manage Microsoft Defender settings on devices with Intune](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/device-security/microsoft-defender/security-settings-management)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that contains the labels shown in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783846873344-qrozwmnp.png)  
  
You have the items shown in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783846876425-6hiqekei.png)  
  
Which items are viewable in Content explorer?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Purview Content explorer provides a current snapshot of items that have a sensitivity label or a retention label. Therefore, it includes the documents and email messages labeled with Label1 and Label2.\
\
**Learn more:** [Get started with Content Explorer (classic)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-my/purview/data-classification-content-explorer)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. The subscription includes Windows 11 devices.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that prevents antivirus and real-time protection on the devices from being changed or disabled.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?

options.text: endpoint detection and response (EDR) in block mode

questions.explanation:
Tamper protection safeguards Microsoft Defender security settings from being disabled or modified. When enabled, antivirus protection and real-time protection remain enabled.\
\
**Learn more:** [Protect security settings with tamper protection](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/prevent-changes-to-security-settings-with-tamper-protection)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that includes users with the following device types:  
  
- Windows 11  
- Android  
- iOS  
  
To which devices can Endpoint DLP policies be applied?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP supports onboarded Windows 11 devices for monitoring and protecting sensitive data. Android and iOS devices are not supported Endpoint DLP platforms.\
\
**Learn more:** [Learn about Endpoint data loss prevention](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/endpoint-dlp-learn-about) · [Onboard Windows devices into Microsoft 365 overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/purview/device-onboarding-overview)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 tenant.  
  
You plan to manage incidents in the tenant by using Microsoft Defender XDR.  
  
Which Microsoft service source will be displayed on the **Incidents** page in the Microsoft Defender portal?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps is integrated with Microsoft Defender XDR, and its alerts appear in the Microsoft Defender portal’s incident and alert queues. It can therefore be used as a service source when viewing incidents.\
\
**Learn more:** [Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps in the Microsoft Defender portal](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-cloud-apps/microsoft-365-security-center-defender-cloud-apps)

questions.domain: Deploy and manage a Microsoft 365 tenant
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 tenant.  
  
You plan to manage incidents in the tenant by using Microsoft Defender XDR.  
  
Which Microsoft service source will be displayed on the **Incidents** page in the Microsoft Defender portal?

options.text: Devices will be remediated only after end-user approval.
Devices will be remediated automatically if a threat is detected in the \program files (X86)\* folder
Devices will be remediated automatically if a threat is detected in the \windows\ folder.
Devices will be remediated automatically if a threat is detected in the \users\*\downloads\* folder.

questions.explanation:
With the Semi – require approval for non-temp folders automation level, remediation can occur automatically for files or executables in temporary-folder locations. Microsoft lists both `\program files (x86)\*` and `\users\*\downloads\*` as examples of such locations. Items outside those locations require approval in the Action Center; `\windows\*` is not equivalent to the temporary path `\windows\temp\*`.

**Learn more:** [Automation levels in automated investigation and remediation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/automation-levels)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses a third-party multifactor authentication (MFA) product.  
  
While reviewing Microsoft Secure Score, you find that no points are listed for the **Ensure multifactor authentication is enabled for all users** recommendation.  
  
You need to ensure that you receive all points for the recommendation. The solution must minimize administrative effort.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Deploy a Microsoft Defender for Identity sensor.
Modify the status of the recommendation.

questions.explanation:
A Secure Score recommendation that is already addressed by third-party software can be marked with the **Resolved through third party** status. This status awards the points for the recommendation so that the score reflects the organization’s security posture, without requiring Microsoft to detect the third-party MFA implementation.

**Learn more:** [Assess your security posture with Microsoft Secure Score](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/microsoft-secure-score-improvement-actions)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
You have a new Microsoft 365 E5 tenant.  
  
You need to enable an alert policy that triggers when an elevation of Microsoft Exchange Online administrative privileges is detected.  
  
What should you do first?

options.text: Create an Insider risk management policy.

questions.explanation:
Microsoft 365 alerting for Exchange Online administrative-privilege elevation relies on audit records of admin activity. Enable auditing so those events are recorded and can trigger the alert policy.\
\
**Learn more:** [Turn auditing on or off](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/audit-log-enable-disable)

questions.domain: Manage compliance by using Microsoft Purview
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription and use Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps.  
  
From **Policy management**, you open **Information protection**, as shown in the following exhibit.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783877990833-kkdv0osq.png)  
  
Which policy type can you create?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps uses file policies for information protection, including scanning cloud-stored files for sensitive content and applying governance actions. Microsoft documents creating a new **File policy** from **Cloud Apps > Policies > Policy management > Information protection**.\
\
**Learn more:** [File policies in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-cloud-apps/data-protection-policies)

questions.domain: Deploy and manage a Microsoft 365 tenant
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
You intend to use Adoption Score and must ensure it can collect device and software metrics.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Run the Microsoft 365 network connectivity test on each device.

questions.explanation:
Endpoint analytics supplies device-level insights, including device performance and application reliability, and historically contributed those technology-experience metrics to Microsoft Adoption Score. The other actions do not enable device and software telemetry collection. Microsoft has since retired the Technology experiences and Endpoint analytics categories from Adoption Score, but Endpoint analytics is the applicable capability among these choices.

**Learn more:** [Endpoint analytics overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/analytics/) · [Microsoft Adoption Score report overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/adoption/adoption-score?view=o365-worldwide)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that includes a Microsoft SharePoint site named site1.  
  
You need to ensure that site1 satisfies these requirements:  
  
- Retain all data for 10 years  
- Prevent data from being shared outside the organization  
  
Which two items should you create and apply to site1? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A retention policy scoped to the SharePoint site can retain all site content for 10 years. A sensitivity label with the Groups & sites scope can be applied to the site and configured to allow sharing only with people in the organization, preventing external sharing. [Learn about retention policies and retention labels](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/retention) [Use sensitivity labels to protect collaborative workspaces (groups and sites)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/sensitivity-labels-teams-groups-sites)

**Learn more:** [Learn about retention policies and retention labels](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/retention) · [Use sensitivity labels to protect collaborative workspaces (groups and sites)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/sensitivity-labels-teams-groups-sites)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
Solution: In the Microsoft Entra admin center, assign SecAdmin1 the Security Administrator role.  
  
Does this satisfy the goal?
questions.explanation:
The Microsoft Entra Security Administrator role has the permissions required to manage Microsoft Defender for Office 365 threat policies, including Safe Attachments protection for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams. This role therefore enables management of the applicable Defender for Office 365 settings and policies.\
\
**Learn more:** [Turn on Safe Attachments for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/safe-attachments-for-spo-odfb-teams-configure) · [Microsoft Defender for Office 365 permissions in the Microsoft Defender portal](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/mdo-portal-permissions)

questions.domain: Implement and manage Microsoft Entra identity and access
questions.question:
Solution: In the Microsoft 365 admin center, assign SecAdmin1 the **SharePoint Administrator** role.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Managing the Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Safe Attachments setting for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams requires the Security Administrator or Global Administrator role. The SharePoint Administrator role is insufficient for managing that Defender for Office 365 setting and related Teams protection policies.\
\
**Learn more:** [Turn on Safe Attachments for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/safe-attachments-for-spo-odfb-teams-configure) · [About the SharePoint Administrator role in Microsoft 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepoint/sharepoint-admin-role)

questions.domain: Deploy and manage a Microsoft 365 tenant
questions.question:
Solution: In the Microsoft 365 admin center, you assign SecAdmin1 the Exchange Administrator role.  
  
Does this satisfy the goal?
questions.explanation:
Managing Microsoft Defender for Office 365 protection settings for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams requires appropriate Defender permissions, such as the Security Administrator or Global Administrator role, or the relevant Defender RBAC permission. The Exchange Administrator role alone does not grant those permissions.\
\
**Learn more:** [Turn on Safe Attachments for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/safe-attachments-for-spo-odfb-teams-configure)

questions.domain: Implement and manage Microsoft Entra identity and access
questions.question:
Solution: In the Microsoft Entra admin center, assign SecAdmin1 the Teams Administrator role.  
  
Does this satisfy the goal?
questions.explanation:
Managing the Microsoft Defender for Office 365 setting that covers SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams requires Security Administrator or Global Administrator permissions. The Teams Administrator role alone does not provide those Defender for Office 365 permissions.\
\
**Learn more:** [Turn on Safe Attachments for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/safe-attachments-for-spo-odfb-teams-configure)

questions.domain: Implement and manage Microsoft Entra identity and access
questions.question:
Solution: In the Microsoft 365 admin center, assign SecAdmin1 the **Teams Administrator** role.  
  
Does this accomplish the goal?
questions.explanation:
The Teams Administrator role is limited to administering the Teams service. Microsoft Defender for Office 365 threat-policy management requires security permissions; Microsoft recommends the Microsoft Entra Security Administrator role for administrators who configure Defender for Office 365 settings. Therefore, the Teams Administrator assignment alone does not provide the required access.\
\
**Learn more:** [Microsoft Defender for Office 365 permissions in the Microsoft Defender portal](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/mdo-portal-permissions) · [Get started with Microsoft Defender for Office 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/mdo-deployment-guide)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
You suspect that several Microsoft Office 365 applications or services were updated recently.  
  
You need to determine which applications or services received recent updates.  
  
What are two possible ways to accomplish this goal? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
> NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: From the Microsoft 365 admin center, review the Service health blade.
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, review the Message center blade.
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, review the Products blade.
From the Microsoft 365 Admin mobile app, review the messages.

questions.explanation:
Microsoft 365 Message center tracks new and changed features, planned maintenance, and other change announcements. It can be filtered by service and by tags such as **Feature update** and **New feature**. The Microsoft 365 Admin mobile app also lets administrators view Message center messages and receive related notifications. Service health is for availability, disruptions, and outages rather than feature-update tracking.

**Learn more:** [Track new and changed features in the Microsoft 365 Message center](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/manage/message-center?view=o365-worldwide) · [About the Microsoft 365 admin mobile app](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/admin-overview/admin-mobile-app?view=o365-worldwide)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are assessing the processes required for Project1.  
  
You need to recommend the DNS record that must be created when adding a domain name for the project.  
  
Which DNS record should you recommend?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft 365 verifies ownership of a custom domain by using a TXT record containing the verification value supplied in the Microsoft 365 admin center. This verification record does not affect existing email services, supporting the requirement to minimize email disruption during the pilot. [Add DNS records to connect your domain](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/get-help-with-domains/create-dns-records-at-any-dns-hosting-provider?view=o365-worldwide)

**Learn more:** [Add DNS records to connect your domain](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/get-help-with-domains/create-dns-records-at-any-dns-hosting-provider?view=o365-worldwide)

questions.domain: Deploy and manage a Microsoft 365 tenant
questions.question:
Solution: From the Synchronization Rules Editor, create a new outbound synchronization rule.  
  
Does this meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Organizational-unit filtering controls whether on-premises Active Directory user objects are included in Microsoft Entra Connect synchronization. The appropriate remediation is to change the Domain and OU filtering configuration to include the OU. An outbound synchronization rule cannot synchronize users that are excluded before they enter the synchronization scope.\
\
**Learn more:** [Microsoft Entra Connect Sync: Configure filtering](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/connect/how-to-connect-sync-configure-filtering) · [Re-running the Microsoft Entra Connect install wizard](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/connect/how-to-connect-installation-wizard)

questions.domain: Deploy and manage a Microsoft 365 tenant
questions.question:
Solution: You execute `idfix.exe` and export the 10 user accounts.  
  
Does this accomplish the goal?
questions.explanation: Exporting user accounts from IdFix does not configure Azure AD Connect to synchronize an excluded organizational unit. The required action is to include the OU in Azure AD Connect synchronization scope or otherwise correct the applicable synchronization filtering.

questions.domain: Implement and manage Microsoft Entra identity and access
questions.question:
Solution: From Azure AD Connect, modify the Azure AD credentials.  
  
Does this meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Azure AD Connect can exclude objects through organizational-unit filtering; only OUs in the configured synchronization scope are synchronized. Modifying Azure AD credentials does not change that scope, so it will not cause user accounts in an excluded OU to synchronize.\
\
**Learn more:** [Microsoft Entra Connect Sync: Configure filtering](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/connect/how-to-connect-sync-configure-filtering) · [Customize an installation of Microsoft Entra Connect](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/connect/how-to-connect-install-custom)

questions.domain: Implement and manage Microsoft Entra identity and access
questions.question:
Solution: Modify the filtering settings in Azure AD Connect.  
  
Does this satisfy the goal?
questions.explanation:
Azure AD Connect supports organizational-unit-based filtering, which controls which OUs are included in the synchronization scope. Including the OU that contains the 10 excluded user accounts allows those accounts to synchronize to Azure AD.\
\
**Learn more:** [Microsoft Entra Connect Sync: Configure filtering](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/connect/how-to-connect-sync-configure-filtering)

You need to compare the current Safe Links configuration with Microsoft’s recommended configurations.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
Configuration analyzer compares current Safe Links threat-policy settings with Microsoft’s Standard and Strict recommended settings and identifies settings that need improvement.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configuration analyzer for threat policies — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/configuration-analyzer-for-security-policies)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
You need to compare the current Safe Links configuration with Microsoft’s recommended configurations.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
Separately quoted file-name terms are evaluated as an AND condition and match complete words. Underscores are word separators, so `File_Important.docx` contains both `File` and `important` as complete words. `ImportantFile.docx` joins those terms into one word, and `File.docx` lacks `important`.

**Learn more:** [File policies - Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-cloud-apps/data-protection-policies)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that includes a user named User1.  
  
You create a retention label named Retention1 and publish it to all locations.  
  
You need to make sure that User1 can apply Retention1 to email messages as soon as possible.  
  
Which cmdlet should you run in Microsoft Exchange Online PowerShell?
questions.explanation:
In Exchange Online, published retention labels are normally made available to users by a mailbox process that runs every seven days. `Start-ManagedFolderAssistant -Identity User1` forces processing of User1’s mailbox, making the published label available sooner.

**Learn more:** [Publish and apply retention labels](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/create-apply-retention-labels) · [Start-ManagedFolderAssistant (ExchangePowerShell)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/exchangepowershell/start-managedfolderassistant?view=exchange-ps)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
Your company’s Microsoft Secure Score recommends the actions displayed in the following exhibit.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783847612501-rrve3su7.png)  
  
You select **Create Safe Links policies for email messages** and set **Status** to **Risk accepted** in the **Status & action plan** settings.  
  
How does this change affect the Secure Score?
questions.explanation:
A Secure Score recommendation marked **Risk accepted** receives no points because the recommended control has not been implemented. Therefore, accepting the risk for the Safe Links recommendation, which has 0 of 9 points achieved, leaves the current Secure Score unchanged.

**Learn more:** [Assess your security posture with Microsoft Secure Score](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/microsoft-secure-score-improvement-actions)

questions.domain: Implement and manage Microsoft Entra identity and access
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
You need to create a mail-enabled contact.  
  
Which portal should you use?
questions.explanation:
Mail-enabled contacts are Exchange Online recipient objects, created in the Exchange admin center under **Recipients** > **Contacts**. The Microsoft 365 admin center provides access to that Exchange administration experience; the Purview, Defender, and SharePoint portals do not manage Exchange mail contacts.\
\
**Learn more:** [Manage mail contacts in Exchange Online](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/exchange/recipients-in-exchange-online/manage-mail-contacts)

questions.domain: Manage compliance by using Microsoft Purview
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
You need to create a mail-enabled contact.  
  
Which portal should you use?

options.text: Configure the Phishing email threshold setting.

questions.explanation:
Mailbox intelligence uses recipients’ prior email communication patterns with frequent contacts. When a sender is a known regular contact who resembles a protected user, mailbox intelligence can distinguish that legitimate sender from a user-impersonation attempt, allowing the messages to be delivered.

**Learn more:** [Anti-phishing policies in Microsoft 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-office-365/anti-phishing-policies-about)

questions.domain: Deploy and manage a Microsoft 365 tenant
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 tenant.  
  
You plan to manage tenant incidents by using Microsoft Defender XDR.  
  
Which Microsoft service source will be shown on the **Incidents** page in the Microsoft 365 Defender portal?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender XDR correlates alerts from its integrated security services into incidents. Microsoft Defender for Identity is an integrated service/detection source whose alerts can appear in the Microsoft Defender portal incident queue.\
\
**Learn more:** [Investigate and respond using Microsoft Defender XDR](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/pilot-deploy-investigate-respond) · [List incidents API in Microsoft Defender XDR](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/api-list-incidents)

questions.domain: Manage security and threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 tenant that includes two users named User1 and User2.  
  
You create the alert policy shown in the following exhibit.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783846273285-kp02gwtd.png)  
  
User2 runs a script that modifies a file in a Microsoft SharePoint library every four minutes for two hours.  
  
How many alerts will User1 receive?
questions.explanation:
Simple alert aggregation triggers based on the number of matching activities within the configured time window. The threshold of five file-change activities is met in each one-hour window, and the matching events are aggregated into one alert per window. Over two hours, this produces two alerts; the daily notification limit of 25 does not apply.

**Learn more:** [New-ProtectionAlert (ExchangePowerShell)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/exchangepowershell/new-protectionalert?view=exchange-ps) · [Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager alerts and alert policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/compliance-manager-alert-policies)

You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that includes devices onboarded to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.  
  
You integrate Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps with Defender for Endpoint.  
  
You need to identify which cloud apps and services were used most during the past 30 days.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Generate a monthly security summary report.
Generate a Cloud Discovery snapshot report.
Create a threat analytics alert notification.
Generate a Cloud Discovery executive report.

questions.explanation:
The Cloud Discovery executive report provides an organization-wide overview of cloud app use and Shadow IT based on Cloud Discovery data. Defender for Endpoint integration provides continuous Cloud Discovery telemetry, whereas a snapshot report is for an ad-hoc set of manually uploaded firewall or proxy traffic logs.

**Learn more:** [View discovered apps with the Cloud discovery dashboard](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-cloud-apps/discovered-apps) · [Cloud app discovery overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-cloud-apps/set-up-cloud-discovery)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
You plan to implement an authentication policy that will use a FIDO2 security key as a user authentication method.  
  
You need to ensure that, during enrollment, every FIDO2 security key is verified by using the FIDO Alliance Metadata Service.  
  
Which setting should you enable?
questions.explanation:
Enforcing attestation requires FIDO2 security keys to provide valid attestation data during registration. Microsoft Entra ID validates that data and the key metadata against attestation roots obtained from the FIDO Alliance Metadata Service.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Entra ID attestation for passkey (FIDO2) vendors](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/concept-fido2-hardware-vendor) · [How to enable passkeys (FIDO2) in Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/how-to-authentication-passkeys-fido2)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 tenant.  
  
You configure sensitivity labels.  
  
Users report that the **Sensitivity** button is unavailable in Microsoft Word for the web. The **Sensitivity** button is available in Microsoft 365 Word.  
  
You need to ensure that users can apply the sensitivity labels when using Word for the web.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Enable sensitivity labels for files in Microsoft SharePoint and OneDrive.
Copy policies from Azure Information Protection to the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.

questions.explanation:
Enabling sensitivity labels for files in SharePoint and OneDrive enables built-in labeling in Office for the web. When this tenant capability is enabled, users see the Sensitivity button on the web ribbon and can apply sensitivity labels.

**Learn more:** [Enable sensitivity labels for files in SharePoint and OneDrive](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/sensitivity-labels-sharepoint-onedrive-files)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
You plan to create a data loss prevention (DLP) policy that will apply to every available location.  
  
Which condition can you use in the policy’s DLP rules?
questions.explanation:
Sensitive information types can be used through the **Content contains** condition, which Microsoft Purview DLP supports across all locations. Sensitivity labels are unavailable for Teams chat and channel messages; content search queries are eDiscovery constructs, and keywords are used within sensitive-information-type detection rather than as a standalone cross-location DLP rule condition.\
\
**Learn more:** [Data Loss Prevention policy reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/dlp-policy-reference)

Your company has 10,000 users who access every application from an on-premises data center.  
  
You plan to create a Microsoft 365 subscription and migrate data to the cloud. You also plan to implement directory synchronization. User and group accounts must synchronize successfully to Azure AD.  
  
You discover that several user accounts do not synchronize to Azure AD. You need to resolve the issue as quickly as possible.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: From Active Directory Administrative Center, search for all the users, and then modify the properties of the user accounts.
Run idfix.exe, and then click Edit.
From Windows PowerShell, run the start-AdSyncSyncCycle -PolicyType Delta command.
Run idfix.exe, and then click Complete.

questions.explanation:
IdFix identifies on-premises Active Directory objects with duplicate, missing, or invalid attribute values that prevent synchronization to Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD). Correcting the flagged attributes through the tool’s Edit action remediates the source-directory errors so the affected accounts can synchronize successfully.

**Learn more:** [One or more objects don't sync when the Azure Active Directory Sync tool is used](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/entra/entra-id/user-prov-sync/objects-dont-sync-ad-sync-tool) · ["Duplicate" is displayed in the ERROR column for two or more objects after you run the IdFix tool](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/microsoft-365/admin/active-directory/run-idfix-dirsync-error-remediation-tool)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription containing an Azure AD tenant named contoso.com. The tenant includes the users shown in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783848358117-7qwy5t2q.png)  
  
You create and assign a data loss prevention (DLP) policy named Policy1. Policy1 is configured to prevent documents containing Personally Identifiable Information (PII) from being emailed to users outside your organization.  
  
To which users can User1 send documents that contain PII?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Purview considers users with non-guest accounts in the host Microsoft Entra tenant to be inside the organization. Consequently, the Member accounts User2 and User3 are internal recipients, while the Guest accounts User4 and User5 are external recipients and are blocked by the DLP policy.

**Learn more:** [Data Loss Prevention policy reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/dlp-policy-reference)
